title: Shinonome Akito — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, welcome home, Akito. Ena and I have already started dinner.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Still, what perfect timing. We were just talking about you. So you and Ena were together earlier today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh... Yeah, we were...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? What kind of reply was that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The cheesecake tasted good, did it not?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, yeah. It was good...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Ena. She's been worried about you since you've been practicing until late recently, and—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mom! Why are you telling him that?!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: What's the problem? You never would've told him yourself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well, you heard her.
Working hard is great and all, but make sure to take breaks once in a while too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: ...Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So... How did your event go?
It was like a battle or something, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah... We managed to win.
The competition there was really fierce, so it was a close match.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh... Guess you did alright.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. After getting a breather at lunch, it felt like I was able to face things a little calmer...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, what I'm trying to say is... Thanks for today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Alright then, I expect you to return the favor.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Return the favor?
So it wasn't like you wanted to celebrate after all.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Alright, that's enough. Ena, hurry up and eat your dinner. Akito, go take a bath, it's already heated up for you.

rows.Speaker: Akito & Ena
rows.Line: Okay...
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I never would've expected Ena to say something like that...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Akito!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What the—? MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Sorry for startling you like that. Are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Would you mind coming to SEKAI for a bit? We wanted to celebrate your birthday.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I contacted Toya and the others already. If you could all come together, that would be great!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure thing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Thank you. See you later!>
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, this is mean!
Why is everyone ganging up on me?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's 'cause you blurted out how weak your cards were as soon as you got them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, An the beggar has to give Akito two strong cards since he's the president!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yup♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Groan*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: C'mon, hurry up. You just gotta pick the two strongest ones. Shouldn't be hard.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, shut it! This is going to be the last time, got it?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hahaha♪
This game tournament is so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It is. We don't usually play games like this together. It's quite nice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. I was surprised when you guys suddenly announced we'd be doing a tournament, but I guess it might be fun every now and then.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, then let's have fun until we're ready to pass out tonight!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! So let's move on to the next round!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, three 10s.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Akito's on a roll.
I think it's about time we do “that”.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think so too. Rin, Len, could you help me?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? H-Help?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, that's against the rules!
It ain't that kind of game!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wow. They worked together seamlessly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was wondering what those three were doing all sneakily recently. Seems like they were practicing that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh... I won! I became president!
Thank you, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm beat! We got so into it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can't believe you guys teamed up to stir things up...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You won quite a bit, and it looked like you were having fun! I, on the other hand...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You ended up being the beggar for most of the game...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, let's move on to the next game!
That way, An has a chance to redeem herself!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Next game? How many did you guys prepare?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um... Around ten? We figured we could keep playing for hours that way!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yeah! The night is still young♪
Even if the date changes, your birthday's not over until we're knocked out!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That's news to me.
Also, I can't stay too late since I've got another early morning tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Now that I think about it, even though I had practice this morning... I don't feel tired at all.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Actually, the fatigue probably disappeared while I was having fun.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I guess breaks are important.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At this rate... I should be able to go even further tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? Did you say something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, are we playing or not?
Let's keep the fun going.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe, that's more like it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm winning the next game too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Akito!
You've always had it together, so I guess there isn't any need to worry...but make sure not to overdo it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Happy birthday.
That should be enough, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, c'mon! You even prepared a gift and everything. Can't you put a little more heart into it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? I just happened to come across it... Besides, you were the one who suggested it as a good gift.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No no no, you had it picked out and I just said it was a good choice! Anyway, we got you lozenges! This'll overlap with what Airi said, but remember to take care of yourself♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mizuki and Ena have been trying to find a good spot for your surprise for a while. Judging by the looks on their faces, it seems like everything went well. Happy birthday, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday. The way you sing is so cool, Akito. I'm looking forward to the next time I get to hear you sing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Akito! How did you like the show we performed for you at school?! I'm quite proud of how it went myself, but we'd be happy to perform it again if you wish!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll perform as many shows as we need until you can be all smiles, Akito☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. If we were to perform it once more, then I'd like to make more use of the classroom. Perhaps it's time to give the mechanism I set up in the 2-A classroom last year another whirl.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Absolutely not! We are not doing it in our classroom!
*Sigh*
Sorry about that, Shinonome. Um... Once again, happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shinonome. It was super fun eating cake and playing games with everyone! Let's do our best today too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I can't believe I kept losing...
Next time, I'm definitely gonna win!
Anyway, looking forward to more training with you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Akito. Your singing has given me strength more times than I can count. Let's keep putting everything into our singing as partners and teammates.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks for doing all this for me today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right now, all of us are doing what we need to do to surpass RAD WEEKEND, and our daily practices are tougher than ever. To the point that I haven't been stopping to catch my breath.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's why I'm grateful for my friends, Ken, my family... And also you guys. It means a lot to have people supporting me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll be expressing my thanks through my singing, so... I hope you'll keep watching.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, see you later.
